title: NoText [No Tooltip Background]
description: Makes all the text in the game invisible!
body:
# NoText v1.0 [No Tooltip Background]
Do you hate text? Or do you not want to read anything in minecraft? then this pack is for you!

![notext](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/952634d2ab51239b06efda0ee33311de781b7b23.png)

**This pack makes all the text in the game invisible. Because of that, you can't read names, subtitles, the text on buttons, etc.**

This is the **second version** of NoText that I have created. More info is given below.

All this pack does is remove any text from the game. If you download this on somebody you know's minecraft without them knowing, you'll probably get a few laughs out of that. Or, maybe you just want a challenge and see how its like to play with no text. Whatever the reason may be, this pack is a funny twist to the vanilla game.

This pack is compatitable with version 1.21 to 26.2 . It is also compatitable with all mods and texture packs EXCEPT FOR the ones that change the font of minecraft _or_ the ones that add a custom tooltip background. So it is recommended to put this resource pack above all other packs in the resource pack menu, so that it does its job properly.

There are 2 versions to this pack: 
1. NoText v1.0 (tooltip bg)   , and,
2. NoText v1.0 (No tooltip bg)

The first one does not remove the puplish-black background that appears when you hover over an item in minecraft, whereas, the second one removes that too. The version you are seeing right now is version 2 (No tooltip bg). If you want to download the one that doesn't remove the tooltip background, [click here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/notext-tooltip-background).

Yep. Thats it. check out [the gallery](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/no_text/gallery) for a preview of the pack.

I hope you like it :)

![made by interdime](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7f4cd1e6749f1e3d58b0d7af6ffc76f7b5e43144.png)
